name: card
description: A titled block of content, optionally linking somewhere. Good for one item in a collection or a summary panel.

use.when: one item among several, or a summary a person scans and may open.
use.not: the only thing on the page, which wants text under a heading, or a record with its own page, which wants the record component.
use.with: a heading above, the cards in a list, one item each; span 4 or 6. For many items of one kind a person compares or hunts through, a list or a collection reads faster than cards.

body.description: Plain text. Blank lines start a new paragraph.

meta.title: Small print
meta.description: Small secondary line such as a date or status.

href.title: Link
href.description: When set, the title becomes a link to this URL.

level.title: Heading level
level.description: Heading level of the title so cards fit the page outline.

keyboard.does: moves focus to the title link when href is set

wcag.notes: Only the title is a link, so the link text stays meaningful (2.4.9), there is one stop per card, and the body stays selectable. With its script a press anywhere on the card follows the link, as people expect, except when selecting words or pressing a control inside it. The title link is a 44px target (2.5.5). A card rises on keyboard focus as on hover.

machine.identify: An article element whose heading is the title. Read the heading text and the href on its link if present.
machine.operate: If the title is a link, activate it to open the item; a press anywhere on the card does the same.
